name: OGLE
summary: Polish-led long-term optical time-domain survey testing dark compact objects and primordial black holes through microlensing in the Magellanic Clouds and Galactic bulge.
detection_principle: High-cadence, multiyear stellar-light-curve monitoring identifies lensing events; detection efficiencies infer the primordial-black-hole dark-matter fraction in different mass ranges.

status.label: Operation supported by evidence
status.evidence: The website gives a high-cadence observing-data period from 2022-10 to 2024-05.

collaboration.name: OGLE collaboration / mission team
collaboration.participants_note: Only examples of lead or participating institutions directly established by the sources are listed. This is not a complete collaboration list, and listing does not imply equal institutional roles.

results.summary: Multiyear LMC and high-cadence samples constrain primordial black holes in different mass ranges; each limit applies only to its specified mass and halo model.

science_scope: Constrains dark-matter distribution and properties through gravity, microlensing or structure statistics; does not directly identify dark-matter particles.
